# opstracer_oncall (Data Source)

Who is on call for a schedule, now or at a given time. Re-read on every plan, so values change as shifts rotate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_schedule" "backend" {
  name = "backend-oncall"
}

data "opstracer_oncall" "now" {
  schedule_id = data.opstracer_schedule.backend.id
}

output "on_call_user_ids" {
  value = data.opstracer_oncall.now.user_ids
}

output "shift_ends_at" {
  value = data.opstracer_oncall.now.until
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `schedule_id` (String) Schedule ID.

### Optional

- `at` (String) RFC 3339 time to evaluate. Defaults to now; the server's evaluation time is stored here.

### Read-Only

- `until` (String) End of the current shift (RFC 3339, UTC), if known.
- `user_ids` (List of String) User IDs on call at `at`. Empty when the shift is uncovered.
